subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should this credential-preservation migration fix land as-is after owner review, or require broader shipped-shape coverage first?
rationale: The code-level fix is narrow and well-proven, but only maintainers can accept the residual upgrade/privacy risk for legacy auth shapes that may exist in shipped installs.

options.title: Land focused fix
options.body: Accept the focused parser-reuse fix with its existing before/after migration proof and tests for both changed writers.

options.title: Add shipped-shape fixture
options.body: Require one more regression fixture based on an observed shipped auth-profile shape before merging.

options.title: Hold for migration bundle
options.body: Pause only if maintainers decide this must be bundled with the separate runtime/startup migration work rather than landed independently.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix
recommendation.body: Accept the focused parser-reuse fix with its existing before/after migration proof and tests for both changed writers.

likelyOwner.reason: The SQLite auth-profile migration surface traces most directly to the merged SQLite auth refactor.
